title: What If You Removed Every Rat From an Island Bigger Than Many Cities?

scenes.text: What if one island got rid of every rat? South Georgia did, and the birds came back.
Rats arrived with whalers and sealers as early as the late 1700s and ate eggs and chicks.
From 2011 to 2015, three helicopters dropped more than 300 tons of bait over the island.
It covered over 100,000 hectares, eight times the previous record, Macquarie Island.
In 2017 and 2018 a team searched with three detection dogs and over 4,600 devices.
They found no rats. The South Georgia pipit made a dramatic recovery.

description:
What if you removed every rat from an entire island?
South Georgia did it, and the birds that rats were eating began to recover.
What should we run through next?
